priorities.finding: Request-context features are the only screened group with positive overall primary lift (+0.00221), positive lift on every holdout day, full coverage, and comparatively strong within-user ranking evidence. Warm-user-and-item GAUC is 0.6312, while cold-user GAUC is 0.6536, indicating useful ranking discrimination across the main user segments.
priorities.recommended_action: Advance request_context to a small confirmatory experiment under the same training-only temporal split; do not expand the feature set broadly before confirmation.

metric_diagnosis: Evidence supports early stopping for all rejected groups: they have negative primary lift, with historical author and item response especially harmful and warm-segment GAUC below 0.5. Request_context improves stable within-user ranking, but top-five performance remains weaker than GAUC, particularly for cold users (nDCG@5 0.4921 versus GAUC 0.6536) and cold items (nDCG@5 0.25 and GAUC 0.5 on only 8 rows); therefore prioritize ranking confirmation rather than claiming top-five gains or cold-item improvement. Do not use current-impression outcomes or aggregate snapshots without per-impression availability timestamps because they risk leakage.
